items.title: Show HN: Ballast – macOS app to clear disk space
items.contentSnippet:
Built a little native MacOS app out of necessity to help me free up some storage on my Mac. I've always been frustrated by the lack of visibility and mysterious nature of the Storage overview especially when it comes to Developer and System Data. Ballast gives you a detailed breakdown of all common sources Mac developers would be familiar with, such as node caches, docker images, AI models and even stale unused project concerns. It's free and yes built with Claude. Try it out!
